Description: Infection of susceptible individuals through exposure to the environmental reservoir of V. cholerae.
Vaccination of susceptible individuals with oral cholera vaccine (OCV).
Recovery from infection, leading to temporary natural immunity.
Shedding of V. cholerae into the environment by infectious individuals.
Waning of natural immunity, returning individuals to the susceptible state.
Waning of vaccine-induced protection over time.

Name: Initial vaccine protection (two-dose, adults)
Description: Initial vaccine protection against clinical disease for adults receiving a two-dose regimen.

Name: Vaccine protection duration (two-dose)
Description: Duration of protection from a two-dose vaccine regimen, after which protection is assumed to be zero.

Name: Vaccine protection duration (single-dose)
Description: Duration of protection from a single vaccine dose, after which protection is assumed to drop to zero.

Name: Relative vaccine effectiveness in children < 5 years
Description: Multiplier for adult vaccine protection to calculate protection for children younger than 5 years.

Name: Baseline two-dose vaccine coverage
Description: Assumed two-dose coverage in baseline vaccination campaign scenarios.

Name: Baseline one-dose vaccine coverage
Description: Assumed one-dose coverage in baseline vaccination campaign scenarios.

Name: High two-dose vaccine coverage
Description: Assumed two-dose coverage in the high-coverage national campaign scenario.

Name: High one-dose vaccine coverage
Description: Assumed one-dose coverage in the high-coverage national campaign scenario.
